title: Retrieve a fossicking permit
summary: This page explains how to retrieve a copy of your last valid fossicking permit online.
intro:
Fossicking is looking for and collecting gems and minerals with hand tools. You must have a permit to fossick in NSW state forests.

You can get a copy of your last valid fossicking permit online.
what_you_need: The email address you used to apply for the permit.

how_to_steps.text: Enter the email address you used to apply for the permit.

more_info.text: Carry your permit with you when you go fossicking.
Follow the rules in the Guide to fossicking in NSW.
Before you visit a state forest, check for:

external_links.text: Important information when visiting state forests

internal_links.text: Apply for a permit to fossick in a NSW state forest

faqs.a: Fossicking is the activity of looking for and collecting gems and minerals using hand tools.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to fossick in NSW state forests?
faqs.a: Yes, you must have a permit to fossick in NSW state forests.

faqs.q: How do I retrieve my last valid fossicking permit?
faqs.a: Select the ‘Retrieve online’ button and enter the email address you used to apply for the permit.
